about_the_game:
Paradise Cleaning!- Days with Marie, My Love - is super-casual action game.
All you have to do is just cleaning out all dirty icons by dragging over them within the time limit.
There are 5+1 dirty icons and each of them can be cleaned by the corresponding Cleaning tools.

NOTE.
All in-game text has been translated using machine translation.




[CHARACTER]



Marie Morgan

Height: 168 cm
Three sizes：B123 (O cup)/W57/H92
Blood Type: B
Hobbies: Horseback riding, appreciating art
Dislikes: Natto (fermented soybeans), pushy people


After graduating from high school, she went alone to study in Japan, which she had always wanted to do. She currently lives with her grandparents.
Her mental age is a little young, and she is cheerful, open-minded, rough around the edges, and very gullible.
He learned Japanese from anime and manga, so his knowledge is a bit skewed.

A friend from high school taught her about the Japanese hentai culture, and she decided to study in Japan.
While learning about the hentai culture with the main character, she becomes fascinated with him.



Features
Easy-to-play design
20 stages
20 adult CGs
11 Achievements
